mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(pr.created_at >= #{todayStart}), 0) AS today_count, COALESCE(SUM(pr.created_at >= #{weekStart}), 0) AS week_count, COUNT(*) AS total_count, COALESCE(SUM(pr.self_assess = 1), 0) AS mastered_count FROM practice_record pr WHERE pr.user_id = #{userId}
SELECT DATE(created_at) AS day, COUNT(*) AS count FROM practice_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND created_at >= #{startDateTime} GROUP BY DATE(created_at) ORDER BY day ASC

SELECT c.id AS category_id, c.name, COUNT(*) AS count, ROUND(SUM(pr.self_assess = 1) / COUNT(*), 4) AS mastered_rate FROM practice_record pr JOIN question q ON q.id = pr.question_id JOIN category c ON c.id = q.category_id WHERE pr.user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY count DESC
